reason: The verdict renderer inserted each frozen gate criterion as an unqualified declarative sentence even when gate passed=false. The wording was amended to label it explicitly as the frozen criterion and to print the observed pass/fail state, preventing a false reading of the unchanged results.
scope: Reviewer-facing wording only. No maps, paired arrays, estimates, confidence intervals, p-values, Holm adjustments, gate logic, classifications, or figures changed.
